response.justification: Bogdan is a versatile, senior software craftsman with a long track record across web, mobile, and systems programming, but his career has been overwhelmingly focused on JavaScript/TypeScript, Node.js, and D-lang ecosystems. There is minimal evidence of recent, deep Java/Kotlin/JVM work, no mention of Spring/Quarkus/Hibernate, and no IDE internals or language tooling experience, all of which are core requirements for this role.
strengths: Extensive senior/staff-level experience across diverse tech stacks and industries
Strong software craftsmanship background (TDD, CI/CD, clean architecture)
Experience building and maintaining developer tooling (test runners, CI infra, workshops)
concerns: No recent or substantial professional Java/Kotlin/JVM experience listed
No mention of Spring, Quarkus, Hibernate, or enterprise application server work
No demonstrated experience with IDE internals or language tooling, a key focus area

key_factors.factor: Lack of Spring/enterprise Java ecosystem experience
No IDE internals or language tooling background
Strong general senior engineering craftsmanship and adaptability
